name: momentum-crypto-rw8-breakout8-pure-v1
description: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-28, DRY-RUN ONLY, NOT EXECUTED. RW8 trial 470 -> 471. Exact live RW7 no-brakes control except ONE design: add Turtle System 2 short units across all eight coins in the same fixed universe/order. Source: Curtis Faith, Original Turtle Trading Rules, sections Volatility/Units/Entries/Stops/Exits, https://www.tradingwithrayner.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/OriginalTurtleRules.pdf. Short below the prior 55 completed UTC daily lows; cover above the prior 20 daily highs or at fill+2N; Wilder ATR20, 1N=1% sleeve equity, one unit per coin, no pyramiding. Adaptations retained from RW5/RW6: hourly-close evaluation (not intraday stop orders), hourly engine-only 2N stop (no native stop), 55-day N seed window, 120h cap and fresh above-to-below crossing required after expiry, same-symbol momentum long takes priority. Other longs can coexist. The original Turtle six-unit correlated-market cap is NOT replicated: eight single units remain subject to unchanged shared gross/margin caps; correlated squeezes may lose about 16% before gaps/costs if all eight units stop. RW7 sizeOnly forbids a separate drawdown veto/liquidation of this leg. Long vt35 remains unchanged; Turtle units use published N-sizing, not vt35 again. Extra completed daily OHLC history is required and hashed, but data source/cuts/asOf/universe/costs/folds/capital/acceptance unchanged. No tuning, backtest, live activation or model-key change.
